chapter: Paris, Lester Young, drugs, Mississippi and later sessions
title: Young musicians should study Black music history
summary: Collins urges young players to study the history of Black music from Africa onward.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Here we go again. I was talking about young musicians, and the extension of what had been done before by the older generation of music. But the young musician should study the history of black jazz, black music. This is particularly. And really get into it because it's quite interesting. It's very informative, as a matter of fact. They really should study this and it's -- it will amaze them what the black musician has, you know, the African from Africa on has contributed as far as music is concerned. [PAUSE]
